meta.title: CV Match | AI-powered CV screening
meta.description: Upload a CV and a job description. CV Match parses both in the background and returns a match score, gaps and tailored interview questions.

footer.madeWith: Made with ❤️ by the Selleo team.

hero.title: Screen CVs against the role in minutes, not hours
hero.description: Upload a candidate's CV and paste the job description. CV Match extracts the content, lets Claude compare them and hands you a match score, strengths, gaps and interview questions.

features.title: Everything a first screening needs
features.description: From upload to interview prep in a single flow.

authSecurity.title: Upload & parse
authSecurity.description: Drop a PDF, DOCX or text CV plus the job posting. Files land in object storage and are parsed in a background worker.

dashboardFoundation.title: AI match report
dashboardFoundation.description: Claude returns a structured report: match score, requirements coverage, strengths, gaps and red flags.

developerErgonomics.title: Interview ready
developerErgonomics.description: Tailored technical, behavioral and gap-probing questions, plus CV feedback you can forward to the candidate.

pricing.title: Open source starter
pricing.description: CV Match is a demo built on the Selleo boilerplate. Self-host it, plug in your Anthropic API key and adapt it to your hiring process.
pricing.additional: Only pay for the Claude API calls your analyses make.
